why: ./chips re-exports PctButton and ./button exports it a second time as PctBtn — one class, not a namesake. The chips card names PctButtonHarness beside its own harnesses, which stands: a class two entrypoints export is what both hand a consumer. The avatar card names it too, and ./avatar exports no such class; that one disagreement, and no other, is the refusal, naming each entrypoint of the class once. By export record each export was a class of the button's selector, and point 2 refused the harness as standing on three.
